name: breseq
description: Computational pipeline for finding mutations in short-read DNA resequencing data

repo.name: breseq
repo.description: breseq is a computational pipeline for finding mutations relative to a reference sequence using high-throughput DNA resequencing data. It is intended for haploid microbial genomes (<20 Mb). breseq is a command line tool implemented in C++ and R.

readme.summary: The README is essentially a placeholder that redirects all documentation to an external wiki, providing no actual content inline.
readme.top_issue: No content in the README itself — installation, usage, examples, and configuration all require visiting an external wiki link.

critical_findings: Lack of input validation in the `analyze_soft_clipping` function
Potential for null pointer dereferences in the `cram_index_load` function
security.summary: The breseq codebase appears to have some security concerns, including lack of input validation and potential for null pointer dereferences, but no critical injection risks or secrets exposure were found.

common_complaints: Data output inconsistencies (TSV headers vary, evidence discrepancies between formats)
Mutation detection failures (missed knockouts, coverage issues)
File handling errors (truncated BAM files, samtools failures)
praise_themes: Community interest in pipeline integration (nf-core modules requested)
sentiment.summary: Actively maintained project with engaged users who appreciate the tool but struggle with documentation gaps, output inconsistencies, and some detection edge cases; moderate maintainer responsiveness with several issues stalled for months despite user engagement.

communication.summary: The maintainer responses are clear, helpful, and patient, with a good level of technical depth. They encourage new contributors effectively.

concerns: 37 open issues with zero closures in past 6 months
No commits or merged PRs in past 6 months
No active contributors in past 6 months
positive_signals: Last commit is relatively recent (November 2025, ~4 months old)
maintenance.summary: The project shows no active maintenance with zero commits, closed issues, and merged PRs in the past 6 months, while accumulating 37 open issues without resolution.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-categorized and appears comprehensive, but lacks clear marking of breaking changes and migration guides.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The README provides some useful links, but lacks clear and concise information for new users to quickly understand and start using the package.
